items.title: Who are Europe’s startup alternatives to Palantir?
items.summary: Europe’s desire for tech sovereignty is giving homegrown startups a chance at contracts held by US suppliers, and Palantir is a key target for disruption. On Wednesday (Nov. 11), German drone maker Helsing unveiled Clarity, an agentic intelligence platform for the military. The $18 billion startup said that the platform is built around customised AI agents trained on military data to help armed forces to process data, identify threats and counter them.
